name: full
description: Unrestricted-working profile, reachable only with an explicit allowFull flag at compose time. The deny baseline shrinks to privilege-escalation and self-run guards; credential and host-state masks stay in place, so delivery credentials never become readable even here.
writable_note: Adapter-supplied at compose time (opts.writableRoots); this file never declares writable roots.

masks.why: runner trust store (counters, breaker, lock, approval stamps) must be invisible to the sandbox
delivery credentials (gh hosts/token) stay masked in every profile
global git config (url.insteadOf, credential.helper, core.sshCommand levers) stays masked in every profile
XDG global git config stays masked in every profile
delivery credentials (ssh keys and config) stay masked in every profile
delivery credentials (netrc) stay masked in every profile
host state: seeded read-only from the runner snapshot, never writable-bound
host state: model-provider auth readable by design, scratch state ephemeral
